summary: Frontend testing completed for 'Chat en línea' button in teacher card. Found and fixed 1 backend bug: contacts API was not returning teachers for students due to incorrect data query. After fix, the Chat en línea button correctly opens MessageCenter with the teacher selected for chat.
passed_tests: Click on 'Mis Cursos' to view courses
Click on 'Ver curso' to enter course detail page (Histortia)
Course detail page loads with 'Tablero' tab active
Teacher card shows 'Sonia Velasquez Romero' with 'Profesor' badge
Two buttons visible: 'Chat en línea' (filled) and 'Enviar mensaje' (outline)
Click 'Chat en línea' opens MessageCenter drawer
Teacher 'Sonia Velasquez Romero' is selected with 'Profesor' label
Chat compose view ready with message input field

bugs_fixed.issue: Contacts API returned empty list for students because: 1) Code looked for user.grade_id but student had grado_id, 2) Code expected grade.subjects array but subjects are in separate collection
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated get_academic_contacts endpoint to: 1) Support both grade_id and grado_id field names, 2) Query subjects collection directly by grade_id instead of expecting subjects array in grade document

data_fixes.fix: Added teacher_id field linking to teacher Sonia Velasquez Romero
Added grade_id field (same value as grado_id) for compatibility

critical_code_review_comments: Backend contacts API had field name inconsistency (grade_id vs grado_id) - fixed
Backend expected subjects array in grade document but subjects are in separate collection - fixed
seed_data_creation: Updated existing data: 1) Added teacher_id to subject 'Histortia', 2) Added grade_id to student 'pepito@gmail.com'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat en línea button in teacher card is fully working. Key implementation: 1) Button in StudentCourseDetailPage.jsx (line 1024-1041) calls onOpenChat with teacher data, 2) onOpenChat sets directChatUser state which is passed to MessageCenter, 3) MessageCenter's AcademicTab handles directChatUser via useEffect (line 917-932) to select the teacher for chat. Backend fix: get_academic_contacts endpoint now queries subjects by grade_id directly instead of expecting subjects array in grade document.

chat_en_linea_button.location: Teacher card in course detail page (right sidebar)
chat_en_linea_button.action: Opens MessageCenter with teacher selected for chat
